title: Galois unit H2 embeds into etale unit H2
statement: For every field K, there is an embedding Field.GaloisUnitsH2 K ↪ (Spec (.of K)).CohomologicalBrauerGroup. This asserts injectivity in one direction only.

proof.text: For Ks = SeparableClosure K and Omega = AlgebraicClosure K, obtain an additive stalk equivalence c and its action-on-germs identity hc. The separable closure is the canonical intermediate field inside the algebraic closure.

The coefficient topology of galoisUnitsTopRep K is definitionally discrete. Apply the general stalk comparison with F = gmSheaf, M = galoisUnitsTopRep K, c, hc, and n = 2. This produces e from etale H2 to continuous Galois H2.
Take e.symm.toEmbedding. The two endpoint abbreviations unfold to the two cohomology groups in the target. This is a forward embedding with unchanged hypotheses.
